title: Classification of Edge-dependent Labels of Nodes in Hypergraphs

problem.claim: Real-world hypergraph systems may contain node labels that vary depending on the hyperedges in which the nodes participate.

narrative_sequence.summary: Defines hypergraphs as nodes connected by hyperedges that may contain any number of nodes.
Explains that hypergraphs represent group interactions more naturally than ordinary graphs.
Identifies edge-dependent node labels as a characteristic of many real-world hypergraph systems.
Illustrates that an author's role can vary across co-authored papers.

unknowns: No method or algorithm is described.
No explicit research gap or stated novelty is provided.
No datasets, experiments, quantitative results, or comparisons are reported.
